name: Claude sessions
description: Live Claude Code sessions on this machine, and how many of them are waiting for you.
author: Ilya Volkov

settings.label: List only sessions waiting for me
settings.help: The counts stay complete either way; this only filters the list of sessions below them.

settings.label: Sessions to list
settings.help: How many sessions to show below the counts. 0 shows the counts only.

settings.label: Stale-lease threshold (seconds)
settings.help: A session's lease is refreshed every 60 s. Past this age the session counts as dead. The default matches claude-monitor's own 180 s lease TTL, so this card and the monitor agree on who is alive.

settings.label: Row note
settings.help: What to show next to each session, alongside its step progress and how long it has been in its current state.

settings.label: Count sessions with no status line
settings.help: A restored tab whose session has not written a status line yet is still a live session. Turn this off to count only sessions whose state is known.

settings.label: Show a per-account breakdown
settings.help: Adds one line counting live sessions per Claude account.

settings.label: Lease registry directory
settings.help: claude-monitor pins this to ~/.claude regardless of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, because one daemon serves every account. Change it only if you moved the runtime tree.

settings.label: Tab-title directory
settings.help: Where the terminal-status skill writes claude-tab-title-<id>.txt. On macOS /tmp is a symlink to /private/tmp; either spelling works.

settings.label: Terminal app to focus
settings.help: Name of the terminal application the Focus action brings to the front. Leave empty to drop the action.
